msg: Hola, buen día. Somos un grupo de 7 amigas de Bogotá. Tres ya tenemos el Open Water, dos quieren probar el minicurso y dos prefieren snorkel. ¿Cuánto saldría por persona saliendo desde Cartagena y hay descuento por grupo?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Buen día! ¡Qué chévere que quieran disfrutar juntas del arrecife! Sí, pueden combinar buceo para certificadas, minicurso y snorkel en la misma salida; según la operación, podrían ir en la misma lancha o dividirse por actividad.

Para las tres certificadas, el plan desde Cartagena es de **2 inmersiones**; te dejo ese precio a continuación.

Sí, por ser un grupo de 7 aplica el **10% de descuento de grupo** al minicurso y al snorkel, además del descuento online. Hay que solicitarlo al equipo antes de pagar; no aplica a cursos PADI.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Minicurso de Buceo: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
• Tour de Snorkeling: 448.000 COP · 497.000 COP

No hay descuento ni tarifa especial por ser colombiano: el precio es el mismo, solo cambia la moneda (COP).

¿Quieres que te ayude a continuar con la reserva?

msg: Hello. My wife and I arrive on a cruise ship in Cartagena on March 3rd, docking at 7:00 am and we must be back on board by 5:00 pm. We would both like to snorkel. Is that doable? We are from Canada.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The snorkeling tour is scheduled to leave Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. and return to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m. Since your ship docks at 7:00 a.m. and you need to be back on board by 5:00 p.m., the timing is very tight, and I can’t confirm whether you’ll make it from the cruise terminal to the meeting point in time.

The tour includes boat transport, two guided snorkeling sessions, snorkeling gear, lunch, park entrance and activity insurance. Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to check whether this can work with your cruise schedule?

🤿 *Snorkeling Tour*
💰 *126 USD* per person (online rate) · 2 people
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, activity insurance, boat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 2 guided sessions with a local guide, snorkeling equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/superficio/3?language=en

Diving Planet policies:
- Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one, the refresher's included (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing. For a certified diver, a flight on the SAME day as the dive NEVER works, whatever the time, even at night: with a flight on Sunday night, the last dive must be on Saturday at the latest; the boat being back before they leave does not fix it. If they say they leave that day without saying how, they are probably flying: tell them this. When answering, first say from what time they can fly and then compare it with their flight; do not start with yes or no.
- If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.
- For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
- Muelle de la Bodeguita, 5 minutes from the historic center, at 8:00 AM. Departing from Cartagena there is no hotel pick-up: each person gets to the dock on their own (ground transportation to the dock is not included).
- By booking you accept our terms and conditions, cancellation policy, and data treatment. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Date changes are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Changes to the number of people on a booking you already made are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). A group does not pay in parts: if the same booking mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group pays in US dollars (USD), residents and Colombians included. A Colombian together with someone who holds a cédula de extranjería, wherever they are from, is not a mixed group: both pay in pesos (COP). The price is the same: only the currency changes (there is no discount for being Colombian).
- If the group mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group booking is paid in US dollars (USD), at the same equivalent price. Someone with a cédula de extranjería does not count as a foreigner, wherever they are from. There is no different price for being Colombian.
- If you are already on the Rosario Islands, we coordinate pick-up and drop-off from hotels with maritime access. In some cases the boat arrives directly at the hotel; in others we indicate the nearest dock or meeting point.
- These plans have different prices because they do not include transport from Cartagena or lunch.
- Pick-up is only on the Rosario Islands: Barú (including Playa Blanca, which is on Barú) is not part of the islands and we do not operate or pick up there; guests staying in Barú depart from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita).
- It depends on the activity: snorkeling from 6 years old; Bubble Makers from 8 to 10 years old (pool mini-course and very shallow water practice, max 2 meters); the dive mini-course and the Open Water course from 10 years old; the Advanced course and the Rescue course from 12. Minors must be accompanied by a demonstrable parent or responsible relative.
- The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
- If you are a certified diver, there are no additional medical restrictions; your liability waiver is the certified-diver one: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). For the refresher day this one is not used: use the course medical form.
- Bringing or drinking alcohol on the boat or during the activity is not allowed, and no alcohol or other substances may be consumed before diving. You must be in good physical condition.
- The booking system on our website. It automatically closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you can no longer book for the next day, and you still book on the website for the next available day.
- To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
- From Cartagena: departure at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita and return at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.). From the islands: hotel pick-up between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. (8:00 a.m. for specialties and 7:30 a.m. on day 2 of some courses). Daytime activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m. (see the activity schedule). Night diving: in the evening (pick-up around 5:30 p.m., back around 7:30 p.m.). Online booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before; after that, you book on the website for the next available day.
- We only close on December 25 and January 1. The rest of the year we operate every day, including public holidays, except for suspension due to adverse weather conditions.
- The tour includes water all day, coconut candy between dives, and lunch (rice with chicken or rice with vegetables). The menu is always the same, it does not change by day/supplier. Vegetarians, vegans, and celiacs receive rice with vegetables. Guests may bring their own food if needed (e.g. allergy or special diet). If the guest has a food allergy, they must inform us before the tour. In multi-day packages departing from Cartagena, lunch is included on the first day only; plans for guests already on the islands do not include lunch.
- Photos and videos are not offered proactively or included in the price. The instructor may take them voluntarily and delivers them by the next day at the latest. Any tip to the instructor for photos/videos is voluntary: each guest gives whatever they like, directly to them. This applies to every activity, including the mini-course (and the refresher, booked as a mini-course), PADI courses and certified-diver trips: not included, the instructor may take them voluntarily.
- The 3, 4, 5, 7 and 9 dive packages are exclusively for certified divers with a minimum Open Water level. They are not available for uncertified beginners.
- Two-day courses (Open Water, Referral Course, Advanced, Rescue and Mindful Diving) require accommodation on the islands: at least one night, the night of day 1 (there is no return to Cartagena on day 1). There is no option to commute from Cartagena on both days. Accommodation is not included and must be booked directly with the hotel. The same goes for multi-day dive packages (4, 5, 7 and 9 dives): you stay on the islands, and accommodation, which is not included, is booked directly with the hotel.
- Private services and closed groups are available, with no fixed price (it depends on the group and the date). A member of our team prepares the quote and coordinates an available instructor for the date.
- Through DIVE TO HEAL, more than 360 people with disabilities have been served. Accepted conditions include: hearing impairment (deaf), visual impairment (blind), reduced mobility (wheelchair), Down Syndrome, Cerebral Palsy, and Autism (depending on level and assessment). All instructors are trained in adaptive diving. Advance notice is recommended. The limitation is the presence of additional medical conditions that contraindicate diving.
- If you're already on the Rosario Islands and your hotel has maritime access, boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.
- We dive in the Rosario Islands, inside the Corales del Rosario y San Bernardo National Natural Park, about 45-60 minutes by boat from Cartagena.
- All daytime activities (dive trips, mini-course, snorkeling, courses and each day of the packages) end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., followed by lunch. Guests departing from Cartagena have lunch included on the islands and the boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.); guests staying on the islands return to their hotel around 12:00-1:00 p.m. for lunch (lunch not included). On overnight courses and packages, day 1's daytime activities also end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., and then you go to your hotel on the islands. Night diving (on plans that include it) is separate, in the evening (see each plan's schedule).
- There is always availability (confirmed by the business). We only close on December 25 and January 1, and a trip can be suspended due to adverse weather. The date and number of people are chosen in the booking link. To book for the next day, you need to do it before 4:30 p.m. (see booking system cutoff). Booking for the SAME day is no longer possible (trips leave in the morning and the website closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before): you book for the next available day.
- Each person can bring one backpack or bag on the boat. If the guest needs to bring a suitcase, it has to be arranged with a member of our team. If they prefer not to take it, we can store the suitcase at our office in Cartagena.
- What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
- At our base on the island there are lockers where you can leave your things (clothes, phone, wallet) while you dive or snorkel.
- There is no minimum number of people: every activity runs even for a single person.
- Activities and courses are taught in Spanish and English. If a participant speaks neither language, they can come with someone who interprets for them, but instruction is still given in Spanish or English.
- Bookings are made on our website, through each activity's link (with the 10% online discount). The system closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you still book on the website, for the next available day. Plans with no booking link (the 3- and 4-dive packages, the 9-dive package from the islands, the 1-dive trip from the islands, Bubble Makers, Divemaster and the private service) are booked by an advisor in this chat.
- Besides the insurance form, each diver fills in a liability waiver. Our team sends it to you to complete (certified divers: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish)), and the confirmation email reminds you if you have not done it yet.
- The mini-course is a one-day try-dive, an introduction to diving: it does not certify, does not count as part of any PADI course and requires nothing from PADI beforehand (no PADI account or PADI online course). It is the same departing from Cartagena or already on the islands: there is no online or emailed theory; the theory is done there, on the day, along with pool practice and 1 ocean dive with an instructor.
- International clients pay 100% by card on the website; with a foreign card the passport is used as the ID document.
- Colombians and residents of Colombia (including holders of a cédula de extranjería) pay in pesos and do not use the website booking link: a team advisor always closes the booking in this chat and sends them the link, QR code or Llave to pay 100% online or a 50% deposit, and the other 50% on the day of the activity, by card or cash. The 50% deposit option is only for them. Nobody pays 100% at the dock without booking online.
- If you leave the next day around noon: from the Rosario Islands it is very tight (pickup is between 9:30 and 9:45 and the activity ends around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), so it is best to confirm it with a team advisor; departing from Cartagena it does not fit (the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m.). To book for the next day you must do it before 4:30 p.m. the day before.
- Customers paying in US dollars book and pay through the online link: the payment is recorded right away and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking; only if the online payment fails does the team send a link to pay by transfer.
- If the booking system or the online payment fails, our team sends you a link to pay by bank transfer, and the 10% online discount is kept (because the online payment failed). Outside that case there is no payment by transfer: the 10% discount is for booking and paying online.
- In groups combining diving and snorkeling, snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few people everyone goes on the same boat; otherwise the group is split by activity.
- Besides our base (Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso, on Isla Grande), other hotels in the area with maritime access are Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras and Pao Pao. Accommodation is not included: it is booked directly with the hotel.
- To book an activity departing from the islands, the customer must already have their hotel and tell us which one: pickup is arranged there. If they don't have it yet, they first book the hotel and message us with its name; then we book. If they booked the activity first, the hotel could be cancelled, it could be full, they could forget to tell us or end up departing from Cartagena. If they stay in a house, an Airbnb or a hotel not on our list, they tell us the name and an advisor confirms the pickup before they book and pay: they do not book until then.
- Returning to Cartagena on a different date from the plan is not included. If the guest wants to stay longer on the islands and come back with us another day, a member of our team arranges it (space on the boat, etc.).
- Departure and pickup times are fixed: they cannot be moved earlier or later. If you need an adjustment, a team advisor reviews it.
- Cancellations due to bad weather are unlikely because the Rosario Islands are in sheltered waters. If the Port Authority (Capitanía de Puerto) closes departures to the islands, we first try to reschedule the activity so you don't lose your booking. If rescheduling is not possible, you get a 100% refund. See the terms and conditions: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Scuba diving is not possible during pregnancy: no mini-course, no dive trips and no courses (DAN and obstetricians advise against it for the whole pregnancy). Surface snorkeling is possible, with her doctor's approval. Whoever comes with her can dive as usual.
- If you get seasick on the boat (the ride to the islands is about 1 hour by speedboat): have a light breakfast before leaving and consider seasickness tablets. If you take any medication, ask your doctor whether you can dive with it.
- We do issue invoices (also to companies). An advisor from our team coordinates the invoice details with the customer.
- There is no maximum age for diving: an older person can dive with the same medical form as everyone else.
- We carry oxygen and a first-aid kit on board, with trained staff, and there is an emergency protocol.
- Groups are small and follow PADI safety standards for each activity.
- The boat is a regular speedboat with no bathroom. On the islands we use the facilities of the hotel where lunch is served: that is where you change, use the bathroom and shower.
- Diving Planet has no parking of its own; there are public car parks in the old town area, and the easiest way to reach the pier is by taxi.
- There is no gift card, but you can book in someone else's name; the date and details are arranged with an advisor.
- Smoking is not allowed on the boat.
- Pets are not allowed on the boat: we go to a National Natural Park.
- Babies and young children who are not yet old enough for any activity (snorkeling starts at 6) can ride the boat with their parents at any age, and they ride free.
- You can bring your own camera on the dives or snorkeling, at your own risk. Diving Planet does not rent cameras.

msg: Hi, my flight lands in Cartagena on Saturday at 11:30 am and I leave on Sunday at 8 pm. I'm PADI Advanced, last dive 3 months ago. Could I fit in some diving? I'm from the UK.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

You’d need to finish your last dive at least 18 hours before your flight. With your Sunday 8:00 p.m. flight, a daytime dive on Saturday would meet that interval—but the Cartagena boat leaves at 8:00 a.m., so you wouldn’t make the departure after landing at 11:30 a.m.

A dive on Sunday wouldn’t work either, since certified divers can’t fly on the same day as diving. The best option would be to dive on Saturday only if you can get to the Rosario Islands before the activity; otherwise, this schedule doesn’t leave time for diving from Cartagena.

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to check whether an island-based option could work?

msg: Solo yo. ¿A qué hora me recogerían en el Cocoliso y tengo que llevar algo? Gracias.
reply:
En Cocoliso te recogerían entre las 9:30 y las 9:45 a. m., y regresarías hacia las 12:00–1:00 p. m. Lleva tu carné de buceo, bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo está incluido. 🐠

También necesitas:
• Estar listo a las 9:30 en tu hotel
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente. El refresher es el minicurso (piscina y una inmersión con instructor) y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Quien viene varios días hace el refresher el primero y bucea los demás.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.

¿Han pasado *más de 2 años* desde tu última inmersión?

msg: Hi there! We're a family from Canada staying in Cartagena next month. My wife and I are both Advanced Open Water divers, and we have two kids, aged 11 and 7. What could each of us do on a day trip from Cartagena, and how much would it cost?
reply:

The Rosario Islands are a lovely family day out! From Cartagena, the boat leaves at 8:00 a.m. and returns at about 4:15 p.m.; lunch and diving equipment are included on the options below.

Certified fun dives are also an option if your child holds an Open Water certification. - **Your 7-year-old:** Can join the **Snorkeling Tour** and enjoy the reef from the surface. Diving activities start at age 8.

The 11-year-old’s mini-course and the snorkeling options are listed below with their prices.

• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD

Would you like to book the two certified divers’ trip and explore the kids’ options?

msg: Thanks. Our 11-year-old has never dived, he isn't certified. And our daughter is the 7-year-old: so is there really nothing she can do? We can't leave her behind, so would she just stay on the boat while the rest of us are in the water?
reply:
Your 11-year-old can do the **Dive Mini Course** without prior experience, or snorkeling. Certified fun dives require an Open Water certification. Your 7-year-old can snorkel and enjoy the reef from the surface; diving activities start at age 8. She doesn’t have to stay on the boat—children can ride along with their parents, and those too young for any activity ride free. Minors must be accompanied by a responsible adult.

For those who haven't chosen yet I'd recommend these options. Which one do they like best? 🐠
• *Dive mini-course* — A first time underwater with an instructor: pool training and a real dive. No experience needed.

Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). - If you're already on the Rosario Islands and your hotel has maritime access, boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.

reply:
The refresher includes pool practice and **one reef dive with a PADI instructor**. It takes the full day, so you can’t add the two-dive trip on the same day. Since you haven’t dived for three years, a refresher is normally required before returning to regular dives.

You could do the refresher on Tuesday and the two-dive trip on Wednesday. The refresher meets at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. and returns to Cartagena at about 4:15 p.m. It includes the boat, equipment, lunch, insurance, park entrance fee, and the pool session plus one ocean dive. It doesn’t include transport to the dock. After your last dive, wait at least 18 hours before flying; for a daytime dive, you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day.

The online discount is applied automatically when booking on our website.

• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

msg: Good, thank you. Two last questions: do you pick me up in Getsemaní or how do I reach the dock, and do I have to bring my certification card or fill in any forms for these two days?
reply:
There’s no hotel pick-up in Getsemaní. Please make your own way to **Muelle de la Bodeguita** for **8:00 a.m.**; ask for **DIVING PLANET at entrance 3**. Ground transportation to the dock isn’t included. Here’s the location: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Muelle+de+la+Bodeguita/@10.4199447,-75.5537609,828m/data=!3m2!1e3!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x8ef62f753729822d:0x1bbcdd8224d0eaaf!8m2!3d10.4199447!4d-75.551186!16s%2Fg%2F113gzkckf?entry=ttu

Please bring your **certification card**; you can show it on the day or send a photo beforehand. For the refresher, you’ll need the **course medical form**: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. You’ll also need to complete the insurance form sent in your booking confirmation email. The certified-diver liability waiver isn’t used for the refresher.

You'll also need:
• If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.

The *refresher* is an instructor-led review before diving again: it is booked as the *Dive Mini Course* and costs *183 USD* per person who needs it. It uses the course medical form (even for certified divers; the link comes with the booking). Are you interested?

reply:
Sí, pueden hacer dos salidas de un día: cada una es ida y vuelta desde Cartagena, así que pueden dormir allí entre ambas. Cada salida incluye dos inmersiones.

Deben solicitarlo al equipo antes de pagar; no se aplica automáticamente. No calculo un precio final con los descuentos.

*Descuento de grupo (5 personas o más):* 10% más, que se suma al 10% online (20% en total reservando online). No es automático: hay que pedirlo al equipo antes de pagar, o se pierde. No aplica a cursos PADI.

¿Quieres que te pase con un asesor para coordinar la reserva y solicitar el descuento que elijan?

🤿 *Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día)*
💰 *630.000 COP* por persona · 6 personas

El pago es en pesos colombianos (COP): pueden pagar *100 % online* o un *anticipo del 50 %* con el enlace, el QR o Llave que envía el asesor, y el *otro 50 % el día de la actividad*.

⚠️ Si alguno lleva *más de 2 años* sin bucear, se añade el *refresher* (el minicurso: piscina y una inmersión con instructor): *655.000 COP* por persona. ¿Es el caso de alguno de ustedes?

msg: Hey! I'm an American diver, Advanced Open Water. I'm renting a house on Airbnb on Isla Grande next week, it's called Villa Marea. I'd like to do two dives. Can you pick me up there? How does that work?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a great way to explore the Rosario Islands’ reefs! For two certified dives, island pick-up is included at no extra charge if your accommodation has maritime access. Since Villa Marea is an Airbnb house, an advisor needs to confirm the pick-up logistics before you book and pay; the boat may come directly to the house or you may need to meet at a nearby dock.

For certified diving, pick-up is between **9:30 and 9:45 a.m.** You’ll transfer to our base to set up your gear, do **two open-water dives** with a surface interval at the base, and return to your accommodation around **12:00–1:00 p.m.** Lunch isn’t included for guests staying on the islands.

Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to confirm pick-up at Villa Marea and help arrange the booking?

¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

El minicurso desde Cartagena incluye también el transporte en lancha a las Islas del Rosario y de regreso, equipo de buceo, almuerzo, seguro, tarifa de ingreso al Parque Nacional Natural y un aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL. El encuentro es a las 8:00 a. m. en el Muelle de la Bodeguita; cada persona llega por su cuenta. El regreso a Cartagena es a las 3:00 p. m., con llegada estimada a las 4:15 p. m.

Te dejo a continuación el precio del minicurso y también el del snorkel, por si prefieren empezar con esa opción.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Minicurso de Buceo: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
• Tour de Snorkeling: 448.000 COP · 497.000 COP

msg: Gracias. Nos interesa el minicurso, para los dos. ¿A qué profundidad se baja? Y mi esposa pregunta si hace falta saber nadar muy bien, porque ella nada lo justo. Quisiéramos ir el sábado 14 de noviembre.
reply:
¡Qué chévere que se animen! En el minicurso se baja hasta 12 metros; lo habitual es estar entre 5 y 12 metros, siempre con instructor PADI.

No hace falta experiencia previa. Sobre saber nadar, no tengo ese requisito confirmado; como ella nada lo justo, es importante que lo revise con el equipo antes de reservar. La fecha que proponen es el sábado 14 de noviembre.

También necesitas:
• No hay teoría que hacer antes: se hace allí, el mismo día, con el instructor.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 12 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

💰 *655.000 COP* por persona · 2 personas

¡Qué bacano que tengas el Advanced! El 5% por equipo propio se aplica si llevas el equipo completo, como el que mencionaste. Al reservar por la web, el 10% online se suma a ese descuento; no necesitas un código.

Con tu certificación Advanced puedes bucear hasta 30 metros. La profundidad real depende del punto de buceo seleccionado; no tengo a la mano los sitios específicos ni puedo asegurar que haya uno de 25 o 30 metros en cada salida.

🤿 *Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día)*
💰 *178 USD* por persona (reservando online)
✅ Incluye: tarifa de ingreso al Parque Nacional Natural, seguro de buceo obligatorio, transporte en lancha rápida Cartagena-Islas-Cartagena, 2 inmersiones guiadas con un profesional PADI certificado, equipo de buceo, almuerzo y aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Salida desde Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *Para más información y hacer tu reserva, haz clic aquí:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=es

Quien no es colombiano ni residente en Colombia paga en dólares (USD) con tarjeta en la web; la tarifa es la misma, solo cambia la moneda.

¿Te ayudo con algo más? Puedo *añadir otra actividad*, resolver dudas o ajustar la reserva. 🤿

msg: Hola, buenos días. Soy Diana, de Bogotá. Quiero sacarme la certificación de buceo y he pensado hacerlo en Cartagena en enero. Tengo asma leve, controlada con inhalador, y hace años que no tengo una crisis. ¿Puedo hacer el curso igual? ¿Cuánto dura y cuánto cuesta?
reply:
¡Hola, Diana! El Curso Open Water dura 2 días y requiere alojarte al menos una noche en las Islas del Rosario; el alojamiento no está incluido.

Para colombianos, el precio es **2.450.000 COP online** o **2.722.000 COP normal**. La teoría se completa en línea antes de la práctica. El primer día incluye piscina y 2 inmersiones; el segundo, otra sesión de piscina y 2 inmersiones más. Desde Cartagena, la salida es a las 8:00 a. m. desde el Muelle de la Bodeguita y el regreso del segundo día es aproximadamente a las 4:15 p. m.

Para preguntas médicas específicas, es importante que hables con nuestro staff calificado para evaluar tu situación particular. Te paso ahora con alguien del equipo, que te escribe por aquí enseguida.

msg: Perfecto, gracias, espero entonces lo del asma. Mientras tanto, otra duda: tengo que estar en Bogotá el lunes para trabajar. Si hago el curso sábado y domingo, ¿puedo coger un vuelo el domingo por la noche, cuando vuelva a Cartagena? Y sobre la teoría, ¿tengo que estudiar algo antes de ir?
reply:
Para el Curso Open Water, la teoría se hace antes en PADI eLearning y debes completarla para empezar la parte práctica; toma aproximadamente 10 a 12 horas.

Sobre el vuelo: después de bucear hay que esperar al menos 18 horas desde la última inmersión. El curso termina el domingo y el regreso a Cartagena es aproximadamente a las 4:15 p. m., así que un vuelo esa misma noche no cumple el intervalo. Además, el curso requiere pasar la noche del sábado en las islas.

El asesor ya tiene tu consulta sobre el asma y te escribirá por aquí.

También necesitas:
• Con este plan debes alojarte al menos 1 noche en las Islas del Rosario (hotel no incluido)
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

Para preguntas médicas específicas, es importante que hables con nuestro staff calificado para evaluar tu situación particular. Te paso ahora con alguien del equipo, que te escribe por aquí enseguida.

msg: Hey! Planning a bachelor party in Cartagena in February, there will be 6 of us from Texas. Three of the guys are certified and three have never dived. We want one day out on the water together. What's the deal price-wise for a group like ours? And can we pay with US credit cards? One of us would pay for everybody.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a great day out in the Rosario Islands! For one day from Cartagena, the three certified divers can do **Fun Dives (2 dives)**, and the three who haven’t dived before can choose a **Dive Mini Course**. The mini-course is an introductory experience, not a certification. I’m leaving the per-person prices below.

Your group qualifies for the **10% group discount**, which can be combined with the **10% online discount**. The group discount must be requested before paying; it isn’t applied automatically.

Yes, one person can pay for everyone with a US credit card. International bookings are paid in full by card on the website, and the cardholder uses their passport as the ID document. You can book the certified dives and mini-course separately here:

- [Fun Dives — 2 dives](https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en)
- [Dive Mini Course](https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en)

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Would you like to use these two activities for your group?

msg: Awesome. So three on the fun dives and three on the mini course, Saturday February 13th, leaving from Cartagena. How do we get that group discount exactly, and what's the final price per person? Also, it's a bachelor party, so would it be cool if we bring a cooler with some beers on the boat for after the dives?
reply:
It applies to both Fun Dives and the mini-course, but it isn’t automatic: request it from the team **before paying**. If you pay before requesting it, it can’t be added afterward.

I can’t calculate or quote the final discounted price per person here.

Bringing or drinking alcohol on the boat or during the activity isn’t allowed, and no alcohol may be consumed before diving. The certified divers’ Fun Dives and the mini-course are separate activities, each with its own booking.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

*Group discount (5 people or more):* an extra 10%, on top of the 10% online discount (20% total when booking online). It isn't automatic: ask the team before paying, or it's lost. It doesn't apply to PADI courses.

I recommend the *2 dives in 1 day* plan in the Rosario Islands. (If you'd rather do more dives, there are *packages* of 3 or more; just tell me.)

Has it been *more than 2 years* since any diver in the group last dived?

msg: Good call on asking: one of the certified guys, Mike, last dived about three years ago. The other two dived last summer. No beers, got it. So what does Mike need to do? And who do I talk to on your team to get the group discount before we pay?
reply:
Mike is still a certified diver, so he can join the group's certified diving normally. Since it's been more than 2 years since his last dive, he'd normally need a **refresher** — a short in-water review with an instructor (pool + one dive). It's a paid service, and it takes its own day: it can't be done on the same day as the dive trip. If he already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, that counts and he can dive directly. Very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a team member.

For the group discount: it's requested from the team **before paying** — if you pay without requesting it, it's lost and not refunded afterward. I can't hand the conversation to a person myself, but I can connect you with a team advisor if you'd like. Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to apply the group discount?

You'll also need:
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
• After diving, wait at least 12 hours before flying

msg: Good afternoon. My name is Anna, I am from Germany. I will stay at the Hotel San Pedro de Majagua on Isla Grande from November 20 to 24. I am a PADI Advanced diver with about 80 dives, my last dive was in September in Egypt. How does it work when I am already on the island: do you pick me up at the hotel, and what does it cost? I would like to dive on two of the days.
reply:
Hi, Anna! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good afternoon, Anna! Diving from Isla Grande is a lovely way to explore the Rosario Islands’ reefs. Since San Pedro de Majagua is one of our base hotels, pick-up and return by boat are included at no extra charge. For daytime dives, pick-up is between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m., and you’ll return around 12:00–1:00 p.m.; lunch isn’t included for island-based plans.

For two days of diving, the 4-dive package includes two daytime dives each day. I’m leaving its price below, along with the other two-day options.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 3 daytime + 1 night dive): 236 USD · 262 USD
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Would you like to book the 4-dive package?

msg: Just me. Okay, I'll start from Cartagena then. What should I bring with me for the two days? I only have my big backpack, can I take it on the boat or leave it somewhere? I'd also love to bring my GoPro. And can I pay in cash when I arrive? My UK card charges me a fee abroad.
reply:
For the two days, bring a swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving gear is included. You can bring one backpack or bag on the boat; if it’s a suitcase, that needs to be arranged with the team, or you can leave it at our Cartagena office. There are lockers at our island base for your smaller belongings while you dive. I don’t have specific information about bringing a GoPro, so I can’t confirm that detail.

As an international guest, payment is 100% by card through the website when booking; cash payment on arrival isn’t available. I understand the foreign-card fee is frustrating.

You'll also need:
• With this plan you must stay at least 1 night on the Rosario Islands (hotel not included)
• The theory is done through PADI eLearning (approx. 10 to 12 hours). You must complete it before starting the practical phase.
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.

🤿 *PADI Basic Course (Open Water)*
💰 *693 USD* per person (online rate)
📚 PADI course: dates, sessions and details are arranged with you.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/basic-course/4?language=en

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

msg: Okay, thanks. So who can tell me about the GoPro? I'd really like to film my first dives, it's kind of the whole point for me. And is storing my backpack at your office free? Last thing: I've got a flight to Medellín on the 19th at 9 in the morning, is that fine if I finish the course on the 18th?
reply:
You can bring your GoPro on the dives, at your own risk. We don’t rent cameras, and underwater photos or videos aren’t included. An instructor may take photos or videos as a voluntary gesture, but that isn’t guaranteed—so bringing your own camera is the best way to make sure you can film.

You can bring one backpack on the boat, so you shouldn’t need to store it at our office. I don’t have the specific detail about whether office storage is free.

For your flight, you need to wait **at least 18 hours after your last dive**. The course’s final dives are on November 18, and the boat returns to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m. that day. A 9:00 a.m. flight on November 19 would be less than 18 hours later, so it wouldn’t meet the required interval. You’d need to change the flight or finish diving earlier.

Diving Planet policies:
- Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one, the refresher's included (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing. For a certified diver, a flight on the SAME day as the dive NEVER works, whatever the time, even at night: with a flight on Sunday night, the last dive must be on Saturday at the latest; the boat being back before they leave does not fix it. If they say they leave that day without saying how, they are probably flying: tell them this. When answering, first say from what time they can fly and then compare it with their flight; do not start with yes or no.
- If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.
- For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
- Muelle de la Bodeguita, 5 minutes from the historic center, at 8:00 AM. Departing from Cartagena there is no hotel pick-up: each person gets to the dock on their own (ground transportation to the dock is not included).
- By booking you accept our terms and conditions, cancellation policy, and data treatment. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Date changes are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Changes to the number of people on a booking you already made are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). A group does not pay in parts: if the same booking mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group pays in US dollars (USD), residents and Colombians included. A Colombian together with someone who holds a cédula de extranjería, wherever they are from, is not a mixed group: both pay in pesos (COP). The price is the same: only the currency changes (there is no discount for being Colombian).
- If the group mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group booking is paid in US dollars (USD), at the same equivalent price. Someone with a cédula de extranjería does not count as a foreigner, wherever they are from. There is no different price for being Colombian.
- If you are already on the Rosario Islands, we coordinate pick-up and drop-off from hotels with maritime access. In some cases the boat arrives directly at the hotel; in others we indicate the nearest dock or meeting point.
- These plans have different prices because they do not include transport from Cartagena or lunch.
- Pick-up is only on the Rosario Islands: Barú (including Playa Blanca, which is on Barú) is not part of the islands and we do not operate or pick up there; guests staying in Barú depart from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita).
- It depends on the activity: snorkeling from 6 years old; Bubble Makers from 8 to 10 years old (pool mini-course and very shallow water practice, max 2 meters); the dive mini-course and the Open Water course from 10 years old; the Advanced course and the Rescue course from 12. Minors must be accompanied by a demonstrable parent or responsible relative.
- The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
- If you are a certified diver, there are no additional medical restrictions; your liability waiver is the certified-diver one: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). For the refresher day this one is not used: use the course medical form.
- Bringing or drinking alcohol on the boat or during the activity is not allowed, and no alcohol or other substances may be consumed before diving. You must be in good physical condition.
- The booking system on our website. It automatically closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you can no longer book for the next day, and you still book on the website for the next available day.
- To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
- From Cartagena: departure at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita and return at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.). From the islands: hotel pick-up between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. (8:00 a.m. for specialties and 7:30 a.m. on day 2 of some courses). Daytime activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m. (see the activity schedule). Night diving: in the evening (pick-up around 5:30 p.m., back around 7:30 p.m.). Online booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before; after that, you book on the website for the next available day.
- We only close on December 25 and January 1. The rest of the year we operate every day, including public holidays, except for suspension due to adverse weather conditions.
- The tour includes water all day, coconut candy between dives, and lunch (rice with chicken or rice with vegetables). The menu is always the same, it does not change by day/supplier. Vegetarians, vegans, and celiacs receive rice with vegetables. Guests may bring their own food if needed (e.g. allergy or special diet). If the guest has a food allergy, they must inform us before the tour. In multi-day packages departing from Cartagena, lunch is included on the first day only; plans for guests already on the islands do not include lunch.
- Photos and videos are not offered proactively or included in the price. The instructor may take them voluntarily and delivers them by the next day at the latest. Any tip to the instructor for photos/videos is voluntary: each guest gives whatever they like, directly to them. This applies to every activity, including the mini-course (and the refresher, booked as a mini-course), PADI courses and certified-diver trips: not included, the instructor may take them voluntarily.
- The 3, 4, 5, 7 and 9 dive packages are exclusively for certified divers with a minimum Open Water level. They are not available for uncertified beginners.
- Two-day courses (Open Water, Referral Course, Advanced, Rescue and Mindful Diving) require accommodation on the islands: at least one night, the night of day 1 (there is no return to Cartagena on day 1). There is no option to commute from Cartagena on both days. Accommodation is not included and must be booked directly with the hotel. The same goes for multi-day dive packages (4, 5, 7 and 9 dives): you stay on the islands, and accommodation, which is not included, is booked directly with the hotel.
- Private services and closed groups are available, with no fixed price (it depends on the group and the date). A member of our team prepares the quote and coordinates an available instructor for the date.
- Through DIVE TO HEAL, more than 360 people with disabilities have been served. Accepted conditions include: hearing impairment (deaf), visual impairment (blind), reduced mobility (wheelchair), Down Syndrome, Cerebral Palsy, and Autism (depending on level and assessment). All instructors are trained in adaptive diving. Advance notice is recommended. The limitation is the presence of additional medical conditions that contraindicate diving.
- If you're already on the Rosario Islands and your hotel has maritime access, boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.
- We dive in the Rosario Islands, inside the Corales del Rosario y San Bernardo National Natural Park, about 45-60 minutes by boat from Cartagena.
- All daytime activities (dive trips, mini-course, snorkeling, courses and each day of the packages) end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., followed by lunch. Guests departing from Cartagena have lunch included on the islands and the boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.); guests staying on the islands return to their hotel around 12:00-1:00 p.m. for lunch (lunch not included). On overnight courses and packages, day 1's daytime activities also end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., and then you go to your hotel on the islands. Night diving (on plans that include it) is separate, in the evening (see each plan's schedule).
- There is always availability (confirmed by the business). We only close on December 25 and January 1, and a trip can be suspended due to adverse weather. The date and number of people are chosen in the booking link. To book for the next day, you need to do it before 4:30 p.m. (see booking system cutoff). Booking for the SAME day is no longer possible (trips leave in the morning and the website closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before): you book for the next available day.
- Each person can bring one backpack or bag on the boat. If the guest needs to bring a suitcase, it has to be arranged with a member of our team. If they prefer not to take it, we can store the suitcase at our office in Cartagena.
- What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
- At our base on the island there are lockers where you can leave your things (clothes, phone, wallet) while you dive or snorkel.
- There is no minimum number of people: every activity runs even for a single person.
- Activities and courses are taught in Spanish and English. If a participant speaks neither language, they can come with someone who interprets for them, but instruction is still given in Spanish or English.
- Bookings are made on our website, through each activity's link (with the 10% online discount). The system closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you still book on the website, for the next available day. Plans with no booking link (the 3- and 4-dive packages, the 9-dive package from the islands, the 1-dive trip from the islands, Bubble Makers, Divemaster and the private service) are booked by an advisor in this chat.
- Besides the insurance form, each diver fills in a liability waiver. Our team sends it to you to complete (certified divers: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish)), and the confirmation email reminds you if you have not done it yet.
- The mini-course is a one-day try-dive, an introduction to diving: it does not certify, does not count as part of any PADI course and requires nothing from PADI beforehand (no PADI account or PADI online course). It is the same departing from Cartagena or already on the islands: there is no online or emailed theory; the theory is done there, on the day, along with pool practice and 1 ocean dive with an instructor.
- International clients pay 100% by card on the website; with a foreign card the passport is used as the ID document.
- Colombians and residents of Colombia (including holders of a cédula de extranjería) pay in pesos and do not use the website booking link: a team advisor always closes the booking in this chat and sends them the link, QR code or Llave to pay 100% online or a 50% deposit, and the other 50% on the day of the activity, by card or cash. The 50% deposit option is only for them. Nobody pays 100% at the dock without booking online.
- If you leave the next day around noon: from the Rosario Islands it is very tight (pickup is between 9:30 and 9:45 and the activity ends around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), so it is best to confirm it with a team advisor; departing from Cartagena it does not fit (the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m.). To book for the next day you must do it before 4:30 p.m. the day before.
- Customers paying in US dollars book and pay through the online link: the payment is recorded right away and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking; only if the online payment fails does the team send a link to pay by transfer.
- If the booking system or the online payment fails, our team sends you a link to pay by bank transfer, and the 10% online discount is kept (because the online payment failed). Outside that case there is no payment by transfer: the 10% discount is for booking and paying online.
- In groups combining diving and snorkeling, snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few people everyone goes on the same boat; otherwise the group is split by activity.
- Besides our base (Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso, on Isla Grande), other hotels in the area with maritime access are Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras and Pao Pao. Accommodation is not included: it is booked directly with the hotel.
- To book an activity departing from the islands, the customer must already have their hotel and tell us which one: pickup is arranged there. If they don't have it yet, they first book the hotel and message us with its name; then we book. If they booked the activity first, the hotel could be cancelled, it could be full, they could forget to tell us or end up departing from Cartagena. If they stay in a house, an Airbnb or a hotel not on our list, they tell us the name and an advisor confirms the pickup before they book and pay: they do not book until then.
- Returning to Cartagena on a different date from the plan is not included. If the guest wants to stay longer on the islands and come back with us another day, a member of our team arranges it (space on the boat, etc.).
- Departure and pickup times are fixed: they cannot be moved earlier or later. If you need an adjustment, a team advisor reviews it.
- Cancellations due to bad weather are unlikely because the Rosario Islands are in sheltered waters. If the Port Authority (Capitanía de Puerto) closes departures to the islands, we first try to reschedule the activity so you don't lose your booking. If rescheduling is not possible, you get a 100% refund. See the terms and conditions: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Scuba diving is not possible during pregnancy: no mini-course, no dive trips and no courses (DAN and obstetricians advise against it for the whole pregnancy). Surface snorkeling is possible, with her doctor's approval. Whoever comes with her can dive as usual.
- If you get seasick on the boat (the ride to the islands is about 1 hour by speedboat): have a light breakfast before leaving and consider seasickness tablets. If you take any medication, ask your doctor whether you can dive with it.
- We do issue invoices (also to companies). An advisor from our team coordinates the invoice details with the customer.
- There is no maximum age for diving: an older person can dive with the same medical form as everyone else.
- We carry oxygen and a first-aid kit on board, with trained staff, and there is an emergency protocol.
- Groups are small and follow PADI safety standards for each activity.
- The boat is a regular speedboat with no bathroom. On the islands we use the facilities of the hotel where lunch is served: that is where you change, use the bathroom and shower.
- Diving Planet has no parking of its own; there are public car parks in the old town area, and the easiest way to reach the pier is by taxi.
- There is no gift card, but you can book in someone else's name; the date and details are arranged with an advisor.
- Smoking is not allowed on the boat.
- Pets are not allowed on the boat: we go to a National Natural Park.
- Babies and young children who are not yet old enough for any activity (snorkeling starts at 6) can ride the boat with their parents at any age, and they ride free.
- You can bring your own camera on the dives or snorkeling, at your own risk. Diving Planet does not rent cameras.

El punto de encuentro es a las 8:00 a. m. en el Muelle de la Bodeguita, a 5 minutos del centro histórico. No hay recogida en el hotel; debes llegar por tu cuenta. El regreso a Cartagena es a las 3:00 p. m., con llegada estimada a las 4:15 p. m.

Como llevas unos 4 años sin bucear, el repaso se hace antes de volver a las salidas: incluye entrenamiento en piscina y una inmersión en el mar con instructor PADI. El precio incluye también la entrada al Parque Nacional, seguro obligatorio, lancha ida y vuelta, equipo, almuerzo y aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL. No incluye el transporte terrestre al muelle ni fotos o videos submarinos.

También incluye:
• Tarifa de ingreso al Parque Nacional Natural
• 2 inmersiones guiadas con un profesional PADI certificado

¿Y para cuántas personas armamos el plan? 😊

msg: What if we dive the day before our flight instead? Also, is lunch included? Then please tell me how to book.
reply:
Diving the day before your flight works perfectly. 🐠 For certified divers, the minimum wait is 18 hours from your last dive, and a 7:00 a.m. flight the next day is fine — the hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. So if you dive the day before, you're good to fly at 7:00 a.m. the next morning.

About lunch: it depends on where you depart from.
• *From Cartagena*: lunch is included (rice with chicken or rice with vegetables), plus water all day and coconut candy between dives. Vegetarians, vegans and celiac guests get rice with vegetables. If you have any food allergy, let us know before the tour.
• *Already on the Rosario Islands*: lunch is not included — those plans don't include transport from Cartagena or lunch.

How to book:
• Bookings are made on our website through each activity's link, with the 10% online discount applied automatically. You pick your date and number of divers there.
• The system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before, so book before that time for the next day.
• International guests pay 100% by card on the website (with a foreign card, the passport is used as the ID document). The payment is recorded right away and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking.
• For recreational dive outings you must present your certified diver card — you can send a photo beforehand or show it on the day.

Here's the link for the 2-dive day trip from Cartagena: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Buenas tardes, somos una familia de Ciudad de México con tres hijos de 7, 11 y 14 años. Mi esposo y yo no tenemos certificación. ¿Qué actividades podemos hacer todos en las islas?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Qué buen plan familiar! En las Islas del Rosario pueden combinar actividades según la edad y experiencia:

- **7 años:** puede hacer snorkel, que es desde los 6 años.
- **11 años:** puede hacer el minicurso de buceo, disponible desde los 10, o snorkel.
- **14 años:** puede hacer el minicurso o el curso Open Water; para el curso de 2 días se necesita dormir al menos una noche en las islas.
- **Tú y tu esposo:** como no tienen certificación, pueden hacer el minicurso de buceo o snorkel.

También es posible combinar actividades en un mismo tour. El programa Bubble Makers es solo para niños de 8 a 10 años, así que no aplica para sus hijos. ¿Ya estarán alojados en las islas o viajarían desde Cartagena?

¡Qué buen plan familiar! Como salen desde Cartagena, pueden elegir entre el minicurso de buceo y el tour de snorkel. El minicurso cuesta **183 USD por persona online** o **204 USD a tarifa normal**; incluye entrenamiento en piscina, una inmersión en el mar con instructor, equipo, lancha ida y vuelta, almuerzo, seguro, entrada al Parque Nacional y aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL. El snorkel cuesta **126 USD por persona online** o **140 USD a tarifa normal**; incluye dos salidas guiadas, equipo de snorkel, lancha ida y vuelta, almuerzo, seguro, entrada al Parque Nacional y aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL. El precio exacto para los cinco depende de la actividad elegida.

Desde Cartagena no hay recogida en el hotel: el punto de encuentro es el Muelle de la Bodeguita a las 8:00 a. m., y cada persona llega por su cuenta.

¿Te animas con el *minicurso*, el *snorkel* o el *curso Open Water*? 🌊

msg: Do you pick us up at the hotel? What time, and do we need to bring our own gear?
reply:
Yes, pick-up and return by boat at Cocoliso are included at no extra charge. Pick-up is usually between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m.; the exact time and meeting point are coordinated with you. Diving gear is included, so you don’t need to bring your own. Bring a swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses, and comfortable clothes.

You'll also need:
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.

Shall we go for the *2-dive trip* for you and, for your companion, the *mini-course*, *snorkeling* or just coming along on the *boat*? 🌊

msg: Hi, I'm a German traveler in Cartagena and I've never dived. I'd like to get my Open Water certification. How long does the course take?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The Open Water course takes **2 days**. It’s a great way to start diving, and no prior certification is needed.

From Cartagena, day 1 starts at **8:00 a.m.** at Muelle de la Bodeguita and includes pool training and two dives. You’ll stay overnight on the islands (accommodation isn’t included). Day 2 includes another pool session and two final dives, with the boat returning to Cartagena at **3:00 p.m.** The course includes online PADI theory before the trip. Would you like the course price and booking link?

Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers).

msg: ¿Ella puede hacer algo en el agua? ¿Y necesitaría algún permiso médico?
reply:
Sí, puede hacer snorkel en superficie, con el visto bueno de su médico. Durante el embarazo no se recomienda bucear con botella.

No tengo información de un permiso médico específico para hacer snorkel; lo importante es contar con la aprobación de su médico. Para ti, como buzo certificado, debes presentar tu carné de buzo certificado.

También necesitas:
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente. El refresher es el minicurso (piscina y una inmersión con instructor) y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Quien viene varios días hace el refresher el primero y bucea los demás.

¿Te animas con la *salida de 2 inmersiones*, un *paquete de varios días* o un *curso avanzado*? 🌊

msg: Entonces nos animamos, ¿cómo reservamos y en qué moneda pagamos? Somos españoles y estamos en un hotel del centro.
reply:

Como están en un hotel del centro, la opción indicada es salir desde Cartagena. Pueden elegir la fecha y el número de personas en este enlace:

El asesor ya tiene el contexto de lo que me contaste y te escribirá por aquí para ayudarles con la reserva.

msg: Hello! I'm from Sydney, certified 10 years ago with about 30 dives. I'm interested in diving a lot in Cartagena. What packages do you have?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Hello!

Accommodation isn’t included. The packages include boat transport from Cartagena, diving equipment, insurance, and park entry; lunch is included on day 1 only for the multi-day packages. The 3-dive package includes lunch.

Since your last dive was 10 years ago, a refresher is normally required before these trips. It takes a separate day, so it can’t be done on the same day as the dive package.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch included (on multi-day plans, the first day's)
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• 5 Dives - 2 days: 392 USD · 436 USD
• 7 Dives - 3 days: 503 USD · 558 USD
• 9 Dives - 4 days: 602 USD · 668 USD
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 188 USD · 209 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD
• 7-dive package (3 days): 432 USD · 480 USD
• 9-dive package (4 days): 544 USD · 605 USD

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

rag.query: Hello! I'm from Sydney, certified 10 years ago with about 30 dives. I'm interested in diving a lot in Cartagena. What packages do you have?
rag.answer:
Hello! The Rosario Islands are a beautiful place to spend several days diving, and we have a few packages for certified divers departing from Cartagena:

- **4 dives over 2 days:** **$316 USD online** or $351 regular. Includes 4 daytime dives; you’ll stay 1 night on the islands.
- **7 dives over 3 days:** **$503 USD online** or $558 regular. Includes 6 daytime dives and 1 night dive; you’ll stay 2 nights.
- **9 dives over 4 days:** **$602 USD online** or $668 regular. Includes 8 daytime dives and 1 night dive; you’ll stay 3 nights.
- **3 dives in 1 day:** **$287 USD online** or $319 regular. Includes 2 daytime dives and 1 night dive; you’ll stay overnight on the islands.

Accommodation isn’t included. The packages include boat transport from Cartagena, diving equipment, insurance, and park entry; lunch is included on day 1 only for the multi-day packages. The 3-dive package includes lunch.

Since your last dive was 10 years ago, a refresher is normally required before these trips. It takes a separate day, so it can’t be done on the same day as the dive package. Would you like to explore the 7- or 9-dive option?

msg: Tell me about the 3-dive package with a night dive. Where would I sleep and is the hotel included?
reply:
The 3-dive package includes two daytime dives and one night dive in one day. You’ll stay overnight at a hotel you choose on the Rosario Islands; accommodation isn’t included, so you book it directly with the hotel. San Pedro de Majagua and Cocoliso are our base hotels, and other nearby options with boat access include Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao.

It includes the boat transfer, diving equipment, insurance, park entrance fee, guided dives, and lunch. Since it’s been more than two years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; as you’ll be there for multiple days, it can be done on the first day, with the dive package on a later day.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch included (on multi-day plans, the first day's)

• 5 Dives - 2 days: 392 USD · 436 USD
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 188 USD · 209 USD
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD

Would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Then I'll give you the exact plan. 🌊

msg: Do I need a refresher since it's been so long? And how do I book?
reply:
Since it’s been 10 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required. It’s a one-day mini course with pool practice and one ocean dive with an instructor, so it can’t be done on the same day as your regular two-dive trip. If you’ve already completed a refresher or PADI ReActivate at another center, that counts.

You can book the refresher online here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en. The 10% online discount is applied automatically. You’ll need to complete the course medical form and bring your certification card; there’s no theory to do beforehand.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

And how many people should I plan for? 😊

🤿 *Tour de Snorkeling*
💰 *448.000 COP* por persona · 2 personas

El pago es en pesos colombianos (COP): pueden pagar *100 % online* o un *anticipo del 50 %* con el enlace, el QR o Llave que envía el asesor, y el *otro 50 % el día de la actividad*.
